sentences.text: % 06.11.2025 1. The Petitioner is a convict, serving life sentence in FIR No. 669/2003 registered at PS. Jahangir Puri, for the offences under Sections 302/376/201 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.

2. The Petitioner's request for grant of a second spell of furlough for a period of two weeks,
submitted on 20th August, 2025, has not been decided till date.
3. Accordingly, the present petition is disposed of with a direction to the State to take an appropriate decision on the said application positively within a period of one week from today.
